{{Top|leg}}
'''Gleb rations''' were developed during the final days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They were easy to transport and could provide most [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] with enough nourishment for an entire day. Gleb rations were flavorless and dull in [[Color/Legends|color]].
